Plastic Discovered In More Than 50% of Plaques From Clogged Arteries

“Plastics are now everywhere, with tiny fragments found in several major organs of the human body, 

In March, a small study in Italy found shards of microplastics in fatty deposits surgically removed from patients who had an operation to open up their clogged arteries – and reported their health outcomes nearly 3 years later.

Following 257 patients for 34 months, the researchers found nearly 60 percent of them had measurable amounts of polyethylene in plaques pulled from their fat-thickened arteries, and 12 percent also had polyvinyl chloride (PVC) in extracted fat deposits. 

PVC comes in both rigid and flexible forms, and is used to make water pipes, plastic bottles, flooring, and packaging. Polyethylene is the most commonly produced plastic, used for plastic bags, films, and bottles, too.

With microplastics previously found coursing through people’s bloodstream, the researchers were reasonably concerned about heart health.

“Observational data from occupational-exposure studies [also] suggest an increased risk of cardiovascular disease among persons who are exposed to plastics-related pollution, including polyvinyl chloride, than that seen in the GENERAL POPULATION,”

Holistic Approach to Hijrah – The prelude – Understanding of the Corruption of Modern Lifestyles, Food, and Health Systems.

The Ummah is sick; indeed, all of humanity is sick, literally, physically, mentally and spiritually. The evil and the criminals seized control of the world, corrupted the natural food created by Allah, Ahsanul Khaliqeen. How many layers of corruption that these corrupter pulled us into? Let’s just place a brief and quick scenario only for now.

(1)
shaitan commanded them to change Allah’s creation. shaitan said, “I will order them to change the creation of Allah” (Sura Nisaa 4:119).

Let me put an analogy to understand the catastrophe these corrupter – guided by shaitan – have brought upon us:

When a manufacturer creates a machine, it also designs its specific parts, accessories, and determines the exact energy source required. What happens if you try to power that machine with a different energy type?
It malfunctions.

This is precisely why we’re becoming sicker than ever before. Allah designed our bodies and created the perfect nourishment/ food for them. How then can our bodies recognize these artificially modified foods?

And then, when you consistently feed your stomach with these corrupted GMO substances, what outcome can you expect? 
Disaster! Complete bodily malfunction.

On the other hand, think of this, how the body yearns for water, and how it feels when that thirst is finally quenched. That’s the essence of it. HE, Al-Musawweer, fashioned this body and designed exactly what gives it life. Subhanallah! 

So now imagine, by eating GMO food, we are giving our body something other than what was created for this body. Isn’t that enough to make us sick? But corruption didn’t end there. 

(2)
They produce these foods using chemical fertilizers, pesticides, herbicides, antibiotics, hormones etc. 

(3)
After that, they preserve it with even more chemicals. 

(4)
Finally, they process and ultra-process these again in the factories adding preservatives, artificial colors, sweeteners, and flavors. 

(5)
Then, after buying, we freeze these foods, destroying their little-left nutrition.

(6)
Thereafter, we cook them in chemically processed toxic oils (like soyabean, sunflower, canola, etc).

(7)
And if that is not enough, we now finally destroy all nutrition by OVERHEATING them, burning them, making them looks like coal (example, BBQ)

(8)
Yet our NAFS still not satisfied, we now add even more chemicals to these dead food to make them crispy, colourful, and artificially flavoured. May Allah protect us from our NAFS.

(9)
Then, we eat these food frequently and on a full stomach even though our stomach doesn’t feel hungry. So, unhealthy food keeps entering our bodies. Thus, we are destroying our health through food alone. 
(What about the heavy metals, microplastics, pollutant water entering into our body through these food?)  
Subhanallah! It is only Allah’s Qadr that we are not dead yet.

(10)
But our lives aren’t stopped with food only.
Our bodies are also constantly bombarded with:
Electromagnetic pollution, radiations (from power lines & electrical grids), 
Mobile radiation (cell towers & smartphones), 
Digital bombardment (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and smart devices), 
Household toxins (microwaves, refrigerators, and ‘smart’ appliances), 
Workplace hazards (computers, routers, and office electronics),
Consumer Goods (Chemical contaminated Plastic packages, lead poisoning from the cooking pans, etc)

(11)
On top of that, our lifestyle, work-style, also directly damages our health further by sitting stationary most of the times.

(12)
Furthermore, the by-product of the modern lifestyle left us most vulnerable to a KILLER, a predator called STRESS. Nothing can deal with this predator that killing us to the core. A daily stresses we go through for going to work on time, sending children to schools on time, job stress, bill stress, and whatnot!
La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! 

(13)
Yet, after all these disaster, we had a chance.
Allah, Al-Khaliq, the Creator, Ahsanul Khaliqeen created this body to heal itself automatically (at night between 10-2 pm body releases healing hormones) but we even destroyed that opportunity due to a lifestyle that causes us sleeping late. 
OBVIOUSLY, THUS GETTING SICK HAS BECOME A ROUTINE LIKE GOING TO A REGULAR HAIRCUT NOW.

(14)
And there comes the final stage for Muslims which destroyed our Dunya and Akhirah both, TAWAQQUL on Allah. 
The current health system became a point of Tawakkul for the Muslims; they trust and rely on the CORRUPT health system more than their RABB, leaving Allah’s cure, who sent a cure for all diseases. Allahu Musta’an.

(15)
Consequently, we enter into the final CORRUPT stage, taking chemical-filled drugs that only provide temporary relief while failing to cure the root causes (like diabetes and heart diseases as a few examples). Thus, destroying our health in the long run.

(16)
But Al-Hamdulillah, you are still alive. You can still make your choices.
You can surrender to this corrupt system or you can take the control of our lives, relying on Allah alone. The choice is yours.

(17)
And Al Hamdulillah! we made our choices. 
We know that achieving ULTIMATE health and a pure Islamic Life can only be achieved by:

(1) REJECTING the corrupt modern food, health and education systems.
(2) Placing complete trust in Allah’s cure, 
(3) And returning to the pure lifestyle of earlier generations, the Organic/ farm-style living.
Bi-Iznillah! En Shaa Allah!

Isn’t it time yet for you to think and make your choice my brother?

May Allah make it easy for us.
May Allah protect us from these evil and corrupt food and health systems.
May Allah help us to win over the evil of our NAFS.
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.
Ameen

:|: A Holistic approach to Hijrah – As Allah commanded, we are supposed to eat only Tayyib (PURE and BENEFICIAL) food. :|:

Bismillah
Al Hamdulillah
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’la Rasulillah!

(1)
Food of human being: ‘Halal and Tayyib’ (حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا)

Aujubillahi Min Asshaitwanir Rajeem.

Surah Al-Baqarah (2:168-173)
يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ كُلُوا مِمَّا فِي الْأَرْضِ حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا خُطُوَاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
“O mankind, eat from whatever is on earth [that is] Halal (lawful) and Tayyib (pure/ beneficial ) and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.”

Subhanallah!
Let’s do a Critical Reasoning of the Ayah here.
What did Allah commanded the people?
To eat from ‘Halal and ‘Tayyib’ food.

(2)
The Ummah that cling only with ‘Halal’ but no regard to Tayyib:

Subhanallah! We Muslims know what is Halal.

When it comes to Halal food, every single Muslim possesses a PhD-level knowledge, Ma Shaa Allah! The concern for Halal food engraved in a Muslim’s mind so much that even a sinning Muslim while engaging in Haram things look for Halal meat.

But when you ask such Muslims about ‘Tayyib’ food, they have little or no understanding. They possess no certain knowledge about it. The astonishing fact is that Muslims even show no concern about what is Tayyib as if Allah’s word stops at Halal only. La Hawa La Wa La Quwata Illa Billah! There’s no regard whatsoever about Tayyib that would make you think Allah’s word has no value to a Muslim. Allahu Musta’an.

Question is, why has that happened? How’s that happened?
How a Muslim gives no importance to Allah’s word?
The reason is deep, out of the scope of the topic of this Article.
If I have to mention very briefly here, it would be like this:
Muslims have been following a ‘Package Islam’ by abandoning the Quran, abandoning the Wahee for a long time.
En Shaa Allah, we will discuss this issue in a proper place.
So, let’s move now to understand ‘Tayyib’ food in the Ayah.
Wa Ma Tawufiqi Illa Billah!

(3)
What’s the place of ‘Tayyib’ in regards to food?

What does it mean to eat ‘Tayyib’?
General meaning, good, pure food and food that benefits you.

But what about Allah’s command of eating the ‘Halal Food’?
First of all, when it comes to the matter of food, Allah Ajja Wa Jalla didn’t only mention the word ‘Halal’ rather, He Al-Hakeem also mentioned ‘Tayyib’ (pure and beneficial) with that. (Examples: Surah Al-Baqarah 2:168, Surah An-Nahl 16:114)

What does it mean?
It means, in regards to food, ‘Halal’ is only one part of the condition of food that are allowed. There is another condition attached to it, which is, that it has to be ‘Tayyib’ as well.

(4)
How important is this condition of food to be “Tayyib’?

The matter becomes such important that if you read other Ayat regarding food, you will find Allah only mentioned about ‘Tayyib’, not even the word ‘Halal’. Such as

“O believers! Eat from the Tayyib (PURE and BENEFICIAL food) we have provided for you. And give thanks to Allah if you ˹truly˺ worship Him ˹alone˺.”
(Surah Al-Baqarah (2:172):

And then, read this Ayah:

فَٱبْعَثُوٓا۟ أَحَدَكُم بِوَرِقِكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ فَلْيَنظُرْ أَيُّهَآ أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًا فَلْيَأْتِكُم بِرِزْقٍ مِّنْهُ وَلْيَتَلَطَّفْ وَلَا يُشْعِرَنَّ بِكُمْ أَحَدًا

“So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is ‘Zaka’ Taw’ama’ and bring you provision from it.”
(Surah Al-Kahf 18:19)

Look at the food the people of the cave was looking for. It’s ‘Zaka’ (أَزْكَىٰ طَعَامًۭا), which means again, the pure/ beneficial food. Not mentioning ‘Halal’.

And then look at the another Ayah where Allah mentioned only ‘Tayyib’ in regards to Rizq, not even the word ‘Halal’


وَٱذۡكُرُوٓاْ إِذۡ أَنتُمۡ قَلِيلࣱ مُّسۡتَضۡعَفُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تَخَافُونَ أَن يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ فَآوَىٰكُمۡ وَأَيَّدَكُم بِنَصۡرِهِۦ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
“And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with pure/ beneficial provisions -(وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ) that you might be grateful.”
(Al-Anfal 8:26)

Subhanallah!
What do you understand from these Ayat?
These Ayat didn’t even mentioned ‘Halal’?
Just only Tayyib or ‘Zaka’
What does this suggest?
Tayyib is like a replacement/ alternative/ similar condition of a food to be Halal.
In other words, whatever is Tayyib that is Halal or whatever is Halal that has to be Tayyib.
A Haram food cannot be a Tayyib food, A food which is not Tayyib cannot be Halal.

(5)
Something to be Halal has to be Tayyib:

Subhanallah!
The critical reasoning of the above Ayat is proven by another Ayah where Allah Al-Hakeem straight away clarified the meaning of Halal as Tayyib:


يَسْأَلُونَكَ مَاذَا أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ قُلْ أُحِلَّ لَكُمُ الطَّيِّبَاتُ وَمَا عَلَّمْتُم مِّنَ الْجَوَارِحِ مُكَلِّبِينَ تُعَلِّمُونَهُنَّ مِمَّا عَلَّمَكُمُ اللَّهُ فَكُلُوا مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ

“They ask you, [O Muhammad], what has been made ‘Halal’ for them? Say, ‘Halal’ for you are ‘Tayyib’ (pure and beneficial) and [game caught by] what you have trained of hunting animals which you train as Allah has taught you. So eat of what they catch for you, and mention the name of Allah upon it, and fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.’”
(Surah Al-Ma’idah 5:4)

Subhanallah!
Did this Ayah confirms from Allah’s clarification that Halal means Tayyib?
Is it not clear from the above Ayah that a food to be Halal has to be Tayyib?
Or
In other words, the food that are not Tayyib is not Halal!
Allahu Akbar!

And finally, I can’t help but to mention this:
What Dua Rasulullah taught us?

“Allahumma Arzukni Rizkkan ‘Taiyyban'”
(O Allah, provide us Rizq that is Tayyib)
(Ibne Majah 925, Saheeh)

That again suggest Halal and Tayyib have the same connotation, same implication.
What is not Tayyib can’t be Halal.
Something to be Halal has to be Tayyib as well.

Subhanallah!
It should not leave any doubt in the mind of a Muslim who gives importance to Allah’s words that a food to be Halal has to be Tayyib.

(6)
So, what is Tayyib (pure and beneficial) food?

Food those are genetically modified?
Food those grown using pesticides?
Food (animal) those grown using antibiotics?
Food that is cross-bred between two different species?
Food that processed with chemicals?
Food that preserved with chemicals?

Subhanallah!
Food means pure and beneficial food.
Not modified,
Not corrupted,
Not Genetically modified,
Not processed with unhealthy fats,
Not processed with additives, preservatives,
Not processed with artificial colours, artificial flavours and artificial sweeteners.
Not preserved with chemicals.

(7)
By the way, what is GMO, Genetically Modified Food actually?

It is the changing of Allah’s creation by the shaitan among humans by the command of shaitan among Jinn, as that’s what shaitan threatened to mislead the son of Adam A’alaihi Wa Sallam.

وَلَأُضِلَّنَّهُمۡ وَلَأُمَنِّيَنَّهُمۡ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُبَتِّكُنَّ ءَاذَانَ ٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمِ وَلَأٓمُرَنَّهُمۡ فَلَيُغَيِّرُنَّ خَلۡقَ ٱللَّهِۚ وَمَن يَتَّخِذِ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَ وَلِيࣰّا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَقَدۡ خَسِرَ خُسۡرَانࣰا مُّبِينࣰا

“And I will mislead them, and I will arouse in them desires, and I will command them so they will slit the ears of cattle, and I will command them so they will change the creation of Allāh.”
(An-Nisa’ 4:119)

In the last part of the Ayah Allah warned those
“And whoever takes Satan as an ally instead of Allāh has certainly sustained a clear loss.”

Thus whenever we eat GMO food, know that it is shaitanic food and we are helping shaitan succeeding by helping in the implementation of shaitan’s plans. May Allah forgive us. May Allah protect us.

(8)
And then, what about Cross-breed and hybrid of crops and animals?

Allah, A’zizul Hakeem, Ahsanul Khaliqeen says He has perfected his all creations, “Who has perfected everything He created” (Surah As-Sazda 32:7).

And Allah says,

فَأَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفࣰاۚ فِطۡرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِي فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَاۚ لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِخَلۡقِ ٱللَّهِۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلۡقَيِّمُ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ 

“So direct your face toward the Deen, inclining to truth, the Fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.”
(Ar-Rum 30:30)

Subhanallah! In what a fundamental context of Islam Allah mentioned this issue!
“لَا تَبۡدِيلَ لِخَلۡقِ ٱللَّهِۚ” (La Tabdeela LiKhalqillah!)”
“No change should there be in the creation of Allāh.”
And that’s Deenul Qayyim!

but these shaitan came up with cross-breed, hybrid and making new creations and we have been eating these corrupt food for many decades while our entire scholarship of Modern Ulama has been sleeping.

(9) :|: Following a ‘Package Islam’ – a Destroyer of the Ummah :|:

Whereas it was the responsibility of the Ulama to warn people about the sins and eating of Haram food. Allah, Azza Wa Zalla clearly criticised and warn Ulama in the following Ayah:

Al-Ma’idah 5:63

لَوۡلَا يَنۡهَىٰهُمُ ٱلرَّبَّٰنِيُّونَ وَٱلۡأَحۡبَارُ عَن قَوۡلِهِمُ ٱلۡإِثۡمَ وَأَكۡلِهِمُ ٱلسُّحۡتَۚ لَبِئۡسَ مَا كَانُواْ يَصۡنَعُونَ

“Why do the rabbis and religious scholars not forbid them from saying what is sinful and devouring what is unlawful? How wretched is what they have been practicing.”

So, why could not our learned Ulama warn Muslims about this shaitanic food?
The only reason, as mentioned before,
Muslims have been following a ‘Package Islam’ by abandoning the Quran, abandoning the Wahee for a long time.

The Salaf didn’t need to be concerned about ‘Tayyib’ food, because, all food were naturally Tayyib, therefore, Halal in their times except what Allah mentioned is Haram.

While in our times, after the technological advancement, when the corrupter started genetically modifying the creation of Allah, our Ulama only needed to be vigilant about where, how and in what aspects this technology is affecting the Ummah and contemplating on every Ayah and every word of the Quran to trigger them about the word Tayyib. Had they do it, for sure, they would have noticed these food do not fit in the criteria of Tayyib for a food to be Halal. Allah knows best.

(10)
Are you still doing Allah’s Deen?

Subhanallah!
How many ways have we not abandoned the Quran?
Kuffar has corrupted the entire food system today by altering Allah’s creation be eat rice, wheat, cattle, fruits or vegetables and we Ummah look for no way out to save our Deen while we read Allah’s book, that doesn’t impact us.

Rasulullah Sallallahu A’laihi Wa Sallam has clearly mentioned,

باب مِنَ الدِّينِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
“‏ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏”‏‏.‏

“A time will soon come when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take on the top of mountains and the places of rainfall (valleys) so as to flee with his Deen from Fitnah/ afflictions.”
(Saheeh Bukhari 19, Abu Dawud 4267.)

O Muslim, when do you think that day will come for you?
That you will think, ‘Now is the time to move to the mountain?’
Kuffar has dismantled the authority of Muslims, wasn’t that a time for you to move to the mountains?
Kuffar has forced their Shariah on you, wasn’t that a time for you to move to the mountains?
Kuffar has submerged you into an ocean of Riba, wasn’t that a time for you to move to the mountains?
Kuffar has successfully corrupted the entire food system aided by shaitan and you’re fed that corrupt / shaitanic food, yet that is not the time for you to think that your Deen needs to be saved?
That you need to move to the mountain to save your Deen?

When do you think, your Deen will be taken away?
Is it when your Salah, Siyam and Hajj are gone?
Know that Kuffar will never take away these from you.
They invite you to their ‘White Palaces’ for Iftar,
They give away their churches to build your Masjid and pray your Salah.
Don’t you understand, that the Deen of yours which only consists of Salah, Siyam and Hajj does not bother the Kuffar at all?

What bothers Kuffar, is the Deen of Islam that consist the Shariah of Allah, which they have demolished long back. But you Jaheel still thinking you’re doing your Deen by living under the Kuffar’s Shariah!
When would it be your time to take the Quran and holdfast onto the Quran?
When would you understand that there can’t be a Deen of Islam for a Muslim submitting to the Kuffar’s Shariah!

Wa Allahu A’lam.
May Allah guide us!
May Allah give us understanding!
May Allah protect us.

Yet Allah’s word doesn’t impact Muslims, so we have to look for scientific evidence to prove the corruption of the food system! So here it is!

(11)
The corruption of the food system could be understood by just one horrible findings:

Report 1:
70% of the food on the shelves is corrupted:
https://mightypursuit.com/blog/the-rise-of-disease-greed-inside-the-global-corruption-of-the-food-industry/

Report 2:
Humans Living in Cities Are Slowly Losing Their Ability to Digest Plants.
https://www.msn.com/en-au/health/other/humans-living-in-cities-are-slowly-losing-their-ability-to-digest-plants/ar-BB1k8s1i?ocid=msedgntp&pc=U531&cvid=ec7a22c5e24849019b606c79f31cb978&ei=424

And here is a research about how corrupted the entire food chain has become:

1. Processed and Ultra-Processed Foods
Modern diets are dominated by processed foods laden with artificial additives, preservatives, refined sugars, and unhealthy fats.

Scientific Findings: A 2019 study published in BMJ linked ultra-processed foods to an increased risk of cardiovascular disease, obesity, and type 2 diabetes. These foods are often high in sugar, salt, unhealthy fats, and artificial additives while lacking essential nutrients.

Source: Srour, B., et al. (2019). ‘Ultra-processed food intake and risk of cardiovascular disease: prospective cohort study (NutriNet-Santé). BMJ’.

2. Chemical Contamination (Pesticides, Antibiotics, etc.)

Antibiotics and Hormones:
Pesticides: The Environmental Working Group (EWG) publishes an annual “Dirty Dozen” list highlighting produce with the highest pesticide residues. Studies have linked pesticide exposure to health issues like cancer, neurological disorders, and hormonal disruptions.

Antibiotics in Livestock:
Livestock is often treated with antibiotics and growth hormones, which can enter the food chain and contribute to antibiotic resistance and hormonal imbalances in humans.

The World Health Organization (WHO) has warned that the overuse of antibiotics in animal farming contributes to antibiotic resistance, a major global health threat.

Source: WHO (2017). ‘Stop using antibiotics in healthy animals to prevent the spread of antibiotic resistance’.

3. Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs)
The results of most studies with GM foods indicate that they may cause some common toxic effects such as hepatic, pancreatic, renal, or reproductive effects.
Scientific Findings: Organizations like the FDA and WHO, concerns remain about the long-term environmental and health impacts of GMOs

For example, a 2015 report by the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) classified glyphosate (a herbicide used with GMO crops) as “probably carcinogenic to humans.”

Source: IARC (2015). ‘Glyphosate Monograph’.

4. Food Adulteration
Adding harmful substances to food (e.g., melamine in milk, artificial colours in spices, or diluted olive oil), compromises safety and quality.

Scientific Findings: A 2018 report by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) found that a significant percentage of food samples tested were adulterated, including milk, spices, and edible oils. Adulterants like melamine, artificial colours, and harmful chemicals pose serious health risks.

Source: FSSAI (2018). ‘National Milk Safety and Quality Survey’.

5. Loss of Nutritional Value
Scientific Findings: A 2004 study published in the Journal of the American College of Nutrition found that Soil depletion from intensive modern farming practices has led to a decline in the nutrient content of crops. Fruits and vegetables today often contain fewer vitamins and minerals compared to those grown decades ago.

For example, the study reported a 6% decline in protein content and a 38% decline in vitamin B2 levels in vegetables over 50 years.

Source: Davis, D. R., et al. (2004). ‘Changes in USDA Food Composition Data for 43 Garden Crops, 1950 to 1999’.

6. Lead poisoning and health: Heavy Metals:
Heavy metals, microplastics, and other pollutants contaminate water and soil, entering the food chain. Seafood, for example, is increasingly affected by microplastics and mercury.

The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that heavy metals like lead and cadmium in food and water can cause severe health issues, including kidney damage and developmental problems in children.

Source: WHO (2021). ‘Lead poisoning and health’.

So now, you know what’s going on, what food you’re eating.

(12)
Dignity Being Muslim

And as usual, you can let it go by saying,
“What can I do? I cannot change the system alone, nor I can get out of the system. And when you go to live off-grid, the challenges are many”:

“What about the children and their future?

Where would we use and benefit from our skills?
What about the earnings?
Do you expect everyone should be a farmer?
And then we are not even physically ready to work on a farm.
Nor our children and women are ready to take the hardship of a farm life.
We are spoiled. We can’t help it brother. We are lost. It’s not easy to get out of this system. But yes, a farm life could be good when you retire!”

Well, you have raised some practical and genuine concerns.
But truly speaking, you’re a lost kind of person, definitely not a character of a Muslim.

A Muslim breaks the shackle of corruption, he doesn’t submit to the corruption. That’s the bottom line about being Muslim. That’s the Dignity being Muslim. You must live by the dignity of a Muslim.

Eating pure food is Allah’s command in the first place, it’s not your choice.
And changing the evil by your hand or tongue or heart is a command and, therefore an obligation to every Muslim. (Sunan At-Tirmidhi 2169, Saheeh)

Therefore, you can understand, Islam doesn’t allow you to be indifferent in the face of corruption. You must have an act.

And you must believe that Allah will be with you when you do what is the right thing to do.
(Surah Nahl 16:128)
You must believe that Allah will show you the way when you take a step for Allah’s cause.
(Surah Al-Ankabut 29:69)

And you must believe when Allah says:
“And whoever fears Allah, He will make for him a way out and provide for him from where he does not expect. (Surah At-Talaq 65:3):

Indeed, unless you have a firm belief in Allah’s words and unless you have the attitude to stand against the the corruption, you will always be a subject to the corruptors.

On the other hand, when you have a firm belief in Allah’s word and you have the attitude to stand against corruption, for you Allah will be sufficient. As Allah promised:

“And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.
(Surah At-Talaq 65:2-3)

As for us, we can only say, It’s your choice. Either obey Allah or obey the corruptors.
But If you want to take a step, we have devised a plan, an off-grid living project that will answer most of your concerns above, En Shaa Allah, Bi-Iznillah!

Wa Allahu A’lam.
We ask Allah that He shows us a way out.
That He save us from the corrupt system.
Ameen.

Hijrah – MISGUIDANCE: Misinterpretation of the Hadith, ‘Moving to the mountain’ but within the Kuffar’s territory, under the Kuffar’s authority, submitting to the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’

:|: Hijrah – MISGUIDANCE: Misinterpretation of the Hadith, ‘Moving to the mountain’ but within the Kuffar’s territory, under the Kuffar’s authority, submitting to the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’! :|:

Bismillah!
Al Hamdulillah!
Wa AsSalatu AsSalamu A’ala Rasulillah!

Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,

باب مِنَ الدِّينِ الْفِرَارُ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي صَعْصَعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏
“‏ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَكُونَ خَيْرَ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِ غَنَمٌ يَتْبَعُ بِهَا شَعَفَ الْجِبَالِ وَمَوَاقِعَ الْقَطْرِ، يَفِرُّ بِدِينِهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ ‏”‏‏.‏

“A time will soon come when the best property of a Muslim will be sheep which he will take on the top of mountains and the places of rainfall (valleys) so as to flee with his Deen from Fitnah/ afflictions.”
(Saheeh Bukhari 19, Abu Dawud 4267.)

(1)
Subhanallah!
When you read this Hadith you would think this Hadith applies to us in our time.

But if you really think ‘out of the box’ (I mean, contemplate), and if you really take the real meaning of what is meant by ‘Deen’, then, Subhanallah, you would realise, this Hadith should have long been applied to our forefathers, at least 4/5 generations back when the authority of Muslim was dismantled, as that’s when the Kuffar started forcing their Deen on Muslims and we were ruled by the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’. Therefore, Muslims should have fled to the mountains at least 100 years back to save their Deen from being afflicted by the Fitnah that Kuffar has forced the Ummah into.

And Subhanallah, this understanding of the above Hadith makes sense when you find another Hadith that supports exactly the same understanding when Rasulullah Sallillahu Alaihi Wa Sallam said,

. بَابُ ذِكْرِ الْفِتَنِ وَدَلَائِلِهَا حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ صَخْرِ بْنِ بَدْرِ الْعِجْلِيِّ، عَنْ سُبَيْعِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ:

فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدْ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيفَةً فَاهْرُبْ حَتَّى تَمُوتَ،

“If you do not find a Khalifah in those days, then flee away until you die, even of you die holding on (to a stump of a tree).”
(Sunan Abu Dawud 4247, Hasan)

Subhanallah!
There’s no doubt that Muslims needed to flee to the mountains at least 100 years back to save their Deen from the Fitnah of the Kuffar.

(2)
Oh, wait!
Muslims back then fought against the Kuffar and might have thought to establish Allah’s Shariah after they kicked out the Kuffar.
But guess what, when the Kuffar left their occupation, they left the ruling to their ‘children’ who were Muslims by name and were doing ‘the FIVE PILLARS’ but continued implementing the ‘Shariah’ of the Kuffar.
Yet the Jaheel ‘Muslims’ among us thought they were ruled by the Muslims.
Subhanallah! It is not how they are ruled rather who is ruling is important to the ‘Jaheel Muslims’.

(3)
But now, let’s see how and to what extent misguidance has led this Ummah to.

When Kuffar was implementing their Shariah on Muslims in their own homeland, Instead of dealing with the Kuffar, or fleeing away from obeying the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’, the Ummah accepted ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ easily. (Except for a few Mujahideen)

Therefore, the Ummah fell into such a depth of misguidance that ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ became Halal to them to the extent that paying Taxes in the Kuffar’s System, as an example, is considered Halal and not paying Taxes is considered Haram to these ‘Muslims’. La Hawla Wa La Quwata Illa Billah!

Thus over time, since the Ummah has taken ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ so granted that just a few generations later they moved to the Kuffar’s lands in millions to live now directly under the authority of the Kuffar’s, submitting to the ‘Shariah’ of the Kuffar’s (except those who were forced.)

But guess what?
They think they are practising Allah’s Deen by obeying the Kuffar’s Shariah! Ajeeb!
So they still read those Hadith and they still apply those Hadith and feed their Hawa.

(4)
So, what do they do with the Hadith now?
You will find the majority of these Jaheel ‘Muslims’ of this Ummah were not concerned about the fact that they are obeying the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ but It’s the corruption of the Kuffar’s ‘Shariah’ that lead them to apply this Hadith.

Subhanallah!
Obeying/ submitting to Kuffar’s Deen was not a concern to them.
The citizenship contract which has Shirk and Kufr embedded in it is not a concern to them.
What concerns them is Fahisa, (adultery, LGBTQ, etc. evils.).

So, they are now thinking of ‘moving to a mountain’ to escape the Fahisa but they do it within the Kuffar’s authority.
So, they make ‘Hijrah’ to a countryside within the Kuffar’s land, under the Kuffar’s authority where they are still subjected to ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’.

They fail to realise that this is not what was meant in the Hadith. It is the evils that are predicted would prevail even under the Muslim authority at the end of the time, as living among the Mushrikeen, obeying the Kuffar, living under the Kuffar’s authority, obeying the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ is already made Haram for a Muslim in the first place.

Therefore, ‘moving to a mountain’ doesn’t make any sense for escaping from cities/ towns under the Kuffar’s authority.
You have to move away entirely from the Kuffar’s authority to a land where Muslims implement or intend to implement Allah’s Shariah.
And Allah knows best.
May Allah grant us the understanding of Haqq.

(5)
Let’s now turn to another group of Muslims.
These Muslims understand Hijrah means going back to their homeland.

But they fail to realise that Hijrah means Hijrah, where the conditions of Hijrah are met. Hijrah doesn’t mean moving from Kuffar’s authority to so-called Muslim countries where the same ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’ is implemented and enforced on Muslims.

Hijrah means you move away from the Kuffar’s authority,
Hijrah means you move away from living under the ‘Kuffar’s Shariah’.
Hijrah means you move away by leaving the Kuffar’s environment entirely, be it from your homeland to wherever it takes.

Therefore, the first thing you need is a shifting of mindset. With the same frame of mind, it won’t make sense to you. Not only changing the spectacle rather you have to change the frame entirely.

(6)
Guess, how you do it?
By only moving to farming-style living (off-grid. Of course, you can have Solar panels),
by forming a community with the Muslims,
by establishing a Madrasah, a University within the community,
by establishing an Islamic environment within your community,
by establishing a self-sustainable economic village for livelihood,
And that’s where the ‘Hijrah Project’ comes into place.
And that’s what this ‘Forum’ is about, to facilitate Hijrah for Muslims to a land where you don’t have to submit to the ‘Shariah’ of the Kuffar.

So, I call out to my Muslim brothers,
Think of the proper Hijrah that will be acceptable for reward from our Rabb, Allah Wa Jalla!

And Allah knows best.
May Allah protect us from Kuffar’s Fitnah!
May Allah save us from obeying ‘Kuffar’s Shariah!’
May Allah make our Hijrah easy.
May Allah accept our effort.
Ameen
